message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can only give you an approximate figure based on recent market averages.

**Approximate conversion (as of late 2023–early 2024):**

| Currency | Rate (USD → GBP) | $20 → £ |
|----------|------------------|--------|
| 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP | ≈ £15.60 |

So, roughly, **$20 is about £15.60**.  

**Important note:** Exchange rates fluctuate constantly due to market conditions, fees, and the specific provider you use (bank, online exchange, etc.). For an exact, up‑to‑date conversion, check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s currency converter, or a dedicated currency‑exchange website.
